description: Defines the SymIntArrayRef type and related functions for handling arrays of SymInt objects, including conversions, comparisons, and utility macros within the c10 namespace.

methods.name: asIntArrayRefUnchecked
methods.description: Converts a SymIntArrayRef to an IntArrayRef without safety checks.

methods.name: asIntArrayRefSlowOpt
methods.description: Safely converts SymIntArrayRef to IntArrayRef if all elements are concrete integers; returns std::nullopt otherwise.

methods.name: asIntArrayRefSlow
methods.description: Converts SymIntArrayRef to IntArrayRef with runtime checks, aborting if any element is heap allocated.

methods.name: asIntArrayRefSlowAlloc
methods.description: Converts SymIntArrayRef to DimVector with forced allocation, ensuring all elements are concrete integers.

methods.name: fromIntArrayRefUnchecked
methods.description: Creates SymIntArrayRef from IntArrayRef without safety checks.

methods.name: fromIntArrayRefKnownNonNegative
methods.description: Creates SymIntArrayRef from IntArrayRef assuming all values are non-negative.

methods.name: fromIntArrayRefSlow
methods.description: Creates SymIntArrayRef from IntArrayRef with range checks.

methods.name: sym_equals
methods.description: Performs element-wise equality comparison of two SymIntArrayRef objects, returning a SymBool.
